name: Click2Drop for WooCommerce
author: click2drop

sections.description:
Click2Drop is a dropshipping and fulfillment platform for online stores. It supplies the products and handles fulfillment and delivery for its partners.

This plugin is intended for approved Click2Drop partners and requires an active Click2Drop account. It is the WooCommerce integration for Click2Drop customers, not a standalone dropshipping service.

Interested in working with Click2Drop? Create an account at click2drop.eu. Once your account is approved, you can connect your WooCommerce store using this plugin.

Once connected, the plugin:

  • connects WooCommerce to your approved Click2Drop account;
  • keeps Click2Drop products, prices and stock up to date in your store;
  • provides Click2Drop delivery methods and pickup points at checkout;
  • sends orders placed with Click2Drop delivery to Click2Drop for fulfillment (orders from before the store was connected are not sent);
  • shows the Click2Drop order status, parcels, tracking and invoices in WooCommerce;
  • marks orders with Click2Drop products as completed once every parcel is delivered.

Available in English and Polish.

External services

This plugin connects to the Click2Drop service (https://click2drop.eu), which supplies the products and fulfills the orders. It does nothing without it. Data is sent only after a store administrator connects the store, and only over HTTPS.

  • Connection: store information (address, name, currency, language, WordPress, WooCommerce and plugin versions) is sent when the store is connected, with its connection status once a day (every 5 minutes while the store is paused in Click2Drop) and when it is disconnected.
  • Delivery rates and pickup points: cart and delivery information (Click2Drop products in the cart, delivery country, postal code and city) is sent when the checkout asks for Click2Drop delivery rates or pickup points.
  • Orders: customer, order and delivery information (name, delivery address, email, phone, products, chosen delivery) is sent when an order is checked before payment and when it is sent for fulfillment.
  • Tracking and invoices: the Click2Drop order number is used to read parcel tracking and download invoices.
  • Synchronization: Click2Drop uses the WooCommerce REST API and webhooks to keep Click2Drop products, prices, stock and order status up to date.

Click2Drop Terms and Conditions (B2B): https://click2drop.eu/en/terms-b2b
Click2Drop Terms and Conditions for Consumers: https://click2drop.eu/en/terms-b2c
Click2Drop Return Policy: https://click2drop.eu/en/return-policy
Click2Drop Privacy Policy: https://click2drop.eu/en/privacy-policy
Click2Drop Cookies Policy: https://click2drop.eu/en/cookies-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate Click2Drop for WooCommerce.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Click2Drop.
  4. Connect your approved Click2Drop account.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Click2Drop account?

Yes. The plugin requires an approved Click2Drop account. You can apply at click2drop.eu; once your account is approved, connect your store from WooCommerce → Click2Drop.

Does the plugin affect my existing WooCommerce products?

No. Click2Drop manages only Click2Drop products. Your own products keep their WooCommerce shipping settings and are ordered separately: a customer cannot place Click2Drop products and your own products in the same order.

Which checkout is supported?

Both the block checkout and the classic checkout.
